title: Page 5
content_zh:
“有事再联络。”她笑指着他手上的纸条。
殷策握着她给的纸条，看着她的笑容，在那一瞬间，有股想把手机号码改回正确的冲动。
“唉……”
“唉唉……”
“你够了没？”殷策头也不抬的道，一个大男人哀声叹气的，吵死了。
“我想念大鱼妹妹。”店长一脸落寞道。
殷策懒懒的抬眼，口味这么不挑？那种笨蛋有什么好？
“不要这样看我，大鱼妹妹的个性很好相处，可惜不懂得人心险恶。”他当她是可爱的妹妹，所以会为了她识人不清的眼光感到可惜，“你这家伙都没和她联络了吧？”把人利用完就丢，恶劣！
“你都这样跟老板说话的吗？”
“大鱼妹妹努力又有干劲，请她来这里当正职好了。”店长建议着。
“目前店里不缺人手。”他开餐厅是为了赚钱，可不是为了让员工交朋友的。
“这种冷血的话，就只有你说得出口！”这家伙竟然是他的大学同窗，天啊——
“她来，你要走吗？”他不做无谓的人力浪费。
店长乖乖的噤口，过了一会儿又忍不住道：“那我可以约她吗？”
“随便你。”
“那我这星期休假，就约她出来玩好了。”店长故意道，想看看老同学的反应。
殷策懒得搭腔。
“你真的都不跟她联络了吗？”
“看情况。”若是她还有利用价值的话。“月底餐厅不是有周年庆的活动吗？准备得怎样？”
“安排得差不多了，活动DM也在印刷中，下星期厂商会送来——不过怕那天人手会不够——你是不是要叫我打给大鱼妹妹，请她过来帮？”店长先猜测道。

“我有说到她吗？”
“看你的脸就知道了。”店长摇头叹气，“想要利用人时才联络，这种缺德事我做不来！”会被雷劈。“那你自己去想办法找工读生吧！”殷策勾起嘴角，店长爱当好人，就让他自己去苦恼。
店长嘴角抽搐了一下，正要为自己出声时，店里的电话响起，他顺手接起道：“你好，对，我是，哦！是大鱼妹妹啊？最近过得怎样？我正在念着你呢！”拉了张椅子，舒适的坐好。
殷策微皱眉头，没想到她会打来。
“店里生意还不错啊！你怎么都不回来坐坐？哦？是喔！”
殷策听着店长聊天的内容，不懂那条鱼为何能跟笑得这么淫的店长聊得这么久？
一点戒心也没有，难怪会被他给利用，活该！
“耶？你也知道周年庆活动？唉！对啊，人手不足，没关系，啊？好吧！你放心，那天薪水我会多贴一点给你，嗯，再见啰！”店长笑容可掬的挂上电话。
“她自愿要来帮忙吗？”没想到那个傻蛋居然呆呆的送上门，真是笨到可以送医了。
“当然，也不想想我跟大鱼妹妹是什么鬼交情。”语气十分得意。
“你不也是想要利用她才联络。”殷策用着店长之前的话语来反击。
“那不一样，这是她主动问起的，而且我平时都有跟大鱼妹妹保持联络。”大鱼妹妹有够贴心，还会主动打电话来说要帮忙。
“你倒是很懂得把握机会。”平时就有在联络？他怎么都不知道。
“大鱼妹妹才不像你，她偶尔会打电话到餐厅里来关心一下状况。”虽然才工作短短三个月，但她跟这里的工作伙伴都有着不错的感情。
她都会打电话到餐厅里来聊天——原来大家都只顾着聊天，都不用工作了是吗？“你说薪水要多贴她一点？”
“应该的，那天的工作量比较大。”
“那好，就从你的薪水中扣吧！”他皮笑肉不笑道：“最近很不景气，就共体时艰一下。”
店长的嘴角抽搐——这只妖魔，分明就是嫉妒他跟大鱼妹妹的感情好，恨恨的瞪他一眼，“你迟早会有报应的。”
“是吗？”他很不以为意的笑道：“那我等着。”
言待榆心情甚好的将机车停在餐厅门口，走进店内，看到之前共事的同事，开心的打着招呼，“店长、小美、英仔。”

“你来了。”店长忙碌的将餐具补齐。
“其他人呢？”她问话的同时，已顺手将水杯摆好。
“都在厨房里帮忙准备，你今天负责带位送餐就行了。”店长将围裙递给她。
言待榆穿上围裙，忙了一会儿，突然想起什么的问：“殷策人呢？他也在厨房吗？”
“他、他可能在忙吧！我刚才还有看到他。”店长眼神闪烁的说着。
在餐厅二楼的殷策冷眼看着楼下的女人，之前还说什么他人好，结果还不是把他的“恩情”全给抛在脑后，进门十分钟后才想起他这个人的存在，看她跟每个人都打成一片，他的心里就觉得很不舒服。
好吧！他是给了她错误的手机号码，但若她真有心，她可以直接打到店里，这样就会问到正确的不是吗？
不想和她照面，殷策趁她在忙碌之余闪人；心情郁闷的来到弟弟的住处，自己拿了备份钥匙开门，慵懒的躺在舒适的沙发上，动也不想动。
殷熵从工作室走出来，打算喝个啤酒消消暑气，看到沙发上的人拧着眉心，“干嘛？”
“来拿点心。”他懒得装笑脸，表情很臭。
“要给员工的吗？”殷熵深知这家伙是不吃甜食的，他分明是要拿这些甜点去招摇撞骗。
“我是个体贴的好老板。”
“少来，拿了就快滚。”
“哥哥我听了这样的话是会伤心的。”他的语气与表情完全是两回事。
“你心情不好吗？是谁得罪你了？”殷熵猜测道。
“谁敢得罪我！”他扬眉。
“这倒是真的。”殷熵双手抱胸，“你不爽就直接去找那个人，不要在这里碍手碍脚的。”
他懒懒的瞟了自家小弟一眼。
“看你的鬼样子，该不会是失恋了吧？”殷熵大笑出声，如果是这样，那就太有趣了。
失恋？凭那个笨女人？殷策冷笑一声，没理会兄弟的讪笑，闭眼假寐。

殷策心情焦躁的看着手上的袋子，不懂自己提着不吃的甜食回家是在干嘛？气闷的拿起手机拨出，一等接通，认出是店长的声音后，“店里有什么状况吗？”
“这次活动办得很成功，老板，你怎么溜走了？”害得大鱼妹妹问起殷策，他只能不断编造着谎言。
他没回答店长的问题，“来支援的人都下班了吗？”
“你是在问大鱼妹妹吗？”
“我是问来支援的人。”这个店长真是愈来愈讨人厌了。
“大鱼妹妹忙完中午这一摊后就下班了。”
“没事了，你去忙吧！”才结束通话，看到熟悉的身影在那里等着，他微微一怔，“你怎么知道我住这里？”
“我问店长的。”她看了他一眼，“你看起来心情不太好？”
他立即恢复平日一贯的温尔笑脸，“可能是太累了，你在这里等很久了吗？”
“还好啦！”她不想让他太过内疚，“这边的景色还满漂亮的。”
“进来吧！”他深吸一口气，觉得自己被她搞得有点心神不宁。
“啊？你方便吗？”
“方便啊！怎么这样说？”他温柔无害的问着。
“因为店长说你不太喜欢被人打扰。”所以她打算送完东西就离开。
“那是在忙的时候。”他面不改色的说谎，“快进来吧！”将锁转开，先进到屋内。
“那就打扰了。”她点了头，跟在他身后，进到屋内，看到一大片落地窗，忍不住惊叹出声。
content_en:
"Contact me if you have any questions." She pointed at the note in his hand with a smile.
Yin Ce held the note she gave him and looked at her smile. At that moment, he had the urge to change his mobile phone number back to the correct one.
"Alas..."
"Alas..."
"Have you had enough?" Yin Ce said without raising his head. A grown man sighed and made a lot of noise.
"I miss Sister Big Fish." The store manager said with a lonely look on his face.
Yin Ce lazily raised his eyes, is he so unsophisticated? What good is that kind of idiot?
"Don't look at me like that. Sister Dayu is easy to get along with, but she doesn't understand how evil people are." He thought of her as a cute sister, so he felt sorry for her unclear vision, "You guys haven't even contacted her, have you?" It's bad to throw people away after using them!
"Is this how you talk to your boss?"
"Sister Dayu is hard-working and motivated. Let's ask her to come here as a full-time employee." The store manager suggested.
"Currently there is no shortage of manpower in the store." He opened the restaurant to make money, not to make friends with his employees.
"Only you can say such cold-blooded words!" This guy turned out to be his college classmate. Oh my god——
"She's here, do you want to leave?" He doesn't want to waste manpower unnecessarily.
The store manager kept silent obediently, but after a while he couldn't help but said: "Then can I make an appointment with her?"
"Whatever you want."
"Then I'm on vacation this week, so I'll ask her out to play." The store manager said deliberately, wanting to see the reaction of his old classmate.
Yin Ce was too lazy to talk.
"Are you really not in contact with her?"
"It depends." If she is still valuable. "Isn't there an anniversary event at the restaurant at the end of the month? How are you preparing?"
"The arrangements are almost complete. The event DM is also being printed. The manufacturer will deliver it next week - but I'm afraid there won't be enough manpower that day - do you want me to call Sister Dayu and ask her to come over and help?" the store manager guessed first.
"Did I mention her?"
"I can tell by your face." The store manager shook his head and sighed, "Contact me only when you want to take advantage of people. I can't do such an unethical thing!" You will be struck by lightning. "Then you can find a way to find work-study students yourself!" Yin Ce raised his lips. The store manager liked to be a good person, so he let him worry about it.
The corner of the store manager's mouth twitched. Just when he was about to speak out for himself, the phone in the store rang. He picked it up and said, "Hello, yes, I am, oh! It's Sister Dayu? How have you been lately? I'm thinking of you!" He pulled up a chair and sat down comfortably.
Yin Ce frowned slightly, not expecting her to call.
"Business in the store is pretty good! Why don't you come back and sit down? Oh? Yes!"
Yin Ce listened to the store manager's chat and didn't understand why the fish could chat with the store manager who smiled so obscenely for so long.
You are not wary at all, no wonder you will be taken advantage of by him, you deserve it!
"Yeah? You also know about the anniversary celebration event? Oh! That's right, there is a shortage of manpower, it doesn't matter, ah? Okay! Don't worry, I will give you a little more salary that day. Well, bye!" The store manager hung up the phone with a pleasant smile.
"Does she volunteer to help?" I didn't expect that idiot to come to the door in a daze. He was really stupid enough to send him to the hospital.
"Of course, I don't want to think about my relationship with Sister Big Fish." His tone was very proud.
"You contacted her because you wanted to use her." Yin Ce used the store manager's previous words to counterattack.
"That's different. She asked about it on her own initiative, and I usually keep in touch with Sister Dayu." Sister Dayu is considerate enough and even calls to ask for help.
"You know how to seize opportunities." Are you always in contact? He has no idea.
"Sister Dayu is not like you. She occasionally calls the restaurant to check on the situation." Although she has only worked for three months, she has a good relationship with her colleagues here.
She would call and come to the restaurant to chat - it turned out that everyone was just chatting andNo need to work anymore, right? "You said her salary should be paid more?"
"That's right. The workload was relatively heavy that day."
"Well, I'll deduct it from your salary!" He said with a smile, "It's been a tough time lately, so let's share the hard times."
The corner of the store manager's mouth twitched - this monster was clearly jealous of his good relationship with Sister Big Fish, and glared at him hatefully, "Sooner or later you will get your retribution."
"Really?" He smiled nonchalantly and said, "Then I'll wait."
Yan Daiyu was in a good mood and parked his motorcycle at the door of the restaurant. He walked into the store and greeted his former colleagues happily, "Store manager, Xiaomei, and Yingzai."
"You're here." The store manager busily filled up the tableware.
"Where are the others?" As she asked, she had already placed the water glasses.
"We are all helping to prepare in the kitchen. You just have to take charge of serving food today." The store manager handed her the apron.
Yan Daiyu put on his apron and worked for a while. Suddenly he remembered something and asked, "Where is Yin Ce? Is he in the kitchen too?"
"He, he might be busy! I saw him just now." The store manager said with twinkling eyes.
Yin Ce, who was on the second floor of the restaurant, looked at the woman downstairs coldly. He had said that she was nice before, but in the end, he had forgotten all his "kindness". He only remembered his existence ten minutes after entering the door. Seeing her getting along with everyone, he felt very uncomfortable in his heart.
All right! He gave her the wrong mobile phone number, but if she really wanted to, she could call the store directly and ask for the correct one, right?
Not wanting to see her face to face, Yin Ce took advantage of her busy schedule to sneak in. He came to his brother's house in a depressed mood, took the backup key to open the door, and lay lazily on the comfortable sofa, not wanting to move.
Yin Entropy walked out of the studio, planning to drink beer to cool off the heat. When he saw the person on the sofa frowning, "What are you doing?"
"Come and get some snacks." He didn't bother to put on a smile, his expression was disgusting.
"Do you want it for the employees?" Yin Entropy knew that this guy didn't eat sweets, so he clearly wanted to use these desserts to show off.
"I'm a good and considerate boss."
"Come on, take it and get out of here."
"Brother, I will be sad after hearing such words." His tone and expression were completely different.
"Are you in a bad mood? Who offended you?" Yin Entropy guessed.
"Who dares to offend me!" He raised his eyebrows.
"It's true." Yin Entropy crossed his arms and said, "If you are unhappy, just go to that person directly and don't get in the way here."
He glanced lazily at his little brother.
"Looking at the way you look, you must be out of love, right?" Yin Entropy laughed out loud. If so, it would be so interesting.
Lost in love? Because of that stupid woman? Yin Ce sneered, ignored his brother's ridicule, closed his eyes and fell asleep.
Yin Ce looked at the bag in his hand anxiously. He didn't understand what he was doing carrying sweets he didn't want to eat home. Frustrated, he picked up his cell phone and dialed. Once connected, he recognized the voice of the store manager and asked, "Is something going on in the store?"
"This event was a success, boss, why did you slip away?" Sister Dayu asked Yin Ce, so he could only keep making up lies.
He did not answer the store manager's question, "Have all the people who came to support gotten off work?"
"Are you asking Sister Big Fish?"
"I'm asking for support." This store manager is getting more and more annoying.
"Sister Dayu will get off work after finishing her lunch work."
"It's okay, go and do your work!" He ended the call and was slightly startled when he saw a familiar figure waiting there, "How did you know I live here?"
"I asked the store manager." She glanced at him, "You seem to be in a bad mood?"
He immediately returned to his usual warm smile and said, "Maybe you are too tired. Have you been waiting here for a long time?"
"It's okay!" She didn't want him to feel too guilty, "The scenery here isThe color is quite beautiful. "
"Come in! "He took a deep breath, feeling a little uneasy because of her.
"Huh? Is it convenient for you? "
"Convenient! How do you say that? he asked gently and harmlessly.
“Because the store manager said you don’t like to be disturbed. "So she planned to leave after delivering the things.
“That was during busy times. He lied without changing his face, "Come in quickly!" "Turn the lock open and enter the house first.
“Then excuse me. "She nodded, followed him, entered the house, saw a large floor-to-ceiling window, and couldn't help but exclaimed in amazement.
